modernization.title: System Architecture Modernization (Cognizant)
modernization.description: Migration from legacy RMI-based monolithic communication toward decoupled, resilient Microservice architecture.

legacy.name: Legacy Architecture
characteristics: Tightly coupled services via JVM-to-JVM stubs

target.name: Target Microservices Architecture
characteristics: Resilient failure domains and API gateways

layers.name: API & Controller Layer
layers.role: REST Endpoints, DTO Validation, Security & Auth Filters

layers.name: Repository / Data Access Layer
layers.role: Spring Data JPA, Custom Queries, Entity Mapping

layers.name: Database Layer (MySQL)
layers.role: Relational Storage, Indexes, Foreign Keys, Acid Compliance

jvmComponents.name: Class Loader Subsystem
jvmComponents.description: Loads, links, and initializes compiled .class bytecode into JVM runtime memory.

jvmComponents.name: JVM Memory: Heap
jvmComponents.description: Shared runtime data area storing object instances and array allocations (Young & Tenured generations).

jvmComponents.name: JVM Memory: Thread Stacks
jvmComponents.description: Per-thread frames containing local variables, operand stacks, and partial method results.

jvmComponents.name: Garbage Collector (GC)
jvmComponents.description: Automated memory management reclaiming unreachable heap objects (e.g. G1GC, ZGC).

jvmComponents.name: Execution Engine & JIT
jvmComponents.description: Bytecode interpreter and Just-In-Time compiler translating frequently executed hotspots to native machine code.
